body:
(a) Both selftest and recv ran blocking in the foreground via the Bash tool. Selftest used the default 120000 ms tool timeout was too tight for a 120 s sleep, so I set 200000 ms; recv used 580000 ms (just above the 540 s block default, under the 600000 max).
(b) Nothing failed and nothing needed a retry. The first recv returned a message immediately.
(c) Add: "Set your tool timeout above selftest's 120 s and above recv's --block-seconds (default 540 s); the default 2-minute shell timeout will kill selftest." Delete: "Paths are as the primary sees them" style ambiguity is outside the docstring; within it, I would delete "(never write channel files by hand)" duplication with the module's intro, as send/recv already imply it.
